# CANDIDATE: EVENING_STAR_RESISTANCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An evening-star candlestick pattern forming at prior-day high or key resistance, with RSI(14)>70 on the third bar, predicts a short-term reversal. This edge exists because overbought exhaustion at resistance often triggers profit-taking and new short interest, especially during low-VIX afternoon sessions when momentum wanes.

## Mechanism

Entry: Identify resistance (prior day high, session high, or swing high). If last three 5-minute bars form evening star (bullish bar → small-bodied bar → bearish bar closing below first bar's midpoint) AND RSI(14)>70 on third bar, enter short at third bar close. Exit: Initial stop above evening star pattern high (first bar high). Target 1R, then trail remaining position with 10% ATR-based chandelier exit. Regime filter: Avoid if VIX>25 or time<12:00 ET; favor low-VIX (<15) after 12:00 ET.
